input_signal: Disruption Alert P >= 0.70 at DC node j
insight_generated: Severe compound disruption vulnerability detected at DC {node_j}. High risk of customer SLA failure.
recommendation: Reroute volume to secondary backup DC; activate emergency stock buffer; evaluate dynamic MILP rebalancing.
action_tier: Tier 2 (Operational Lead Approval required) or Tier 3 if financial exposure >= ₹25L

input_signal: DC Throughput Volume approaching rated ceiling
insight_generated: DC {node_j} is operating at {utilization}% capacity, creating network throughput bottleneck.
recommendation: Rebalance destination market assignments to adjacent low-utilization facility; adjust plant dispatch allocations.
action_tier: Tier 1 if cost impact < ₹5L, else Tier 2
human_approval_required: Conditional (True if cost variance >= ₹5L or SLA degradation > 0)

input_signal: External Market Signal (e.g. Diesel price hike +8% or Port Strike)
insight_generated: External freight cost escalation detected on Lane {origin}->{dest}.
recommendation: Re-run MILP optimization solver to identify modal shift (Road to Rail) or alternative sourcing lanes.

input_signal: MILP Solver identifies cost reduction topology
insight_generated: Optimized network topology delivers ₹{cost_savings} ({savings_pct}%) cost reduction while maintaining {fill_rate}% SLA.
recommendation: Adopt prescriptive dispatch schedule; reassign lane flow allocations.
action_tier: Tier 1 if total cost shift < ₹5L, else Tier 2

input_signal: Statistical Break in Historical Demand detected
insight_generated: Permanent demand level shift detected for Product {sku} in Region {mkt}.
